{{Quote|I'm Sergeant Travi Pott, big-time hero. I wasn't even supposed to be assigned to this scrapyard of a planet, but I'm here, and I've got a job to do.|Travi Pott|<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />}}
'''Travi Pott''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Separatist War]] between a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist Movement]] and the Republic-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], Pott was mistakenly assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and was stationed on the island of [[Avilatan]]. By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], she had been assigned to lead her [[Travi Pott's squad|squad]] to destroy Separatist [[Jammer/Legends|jamming beacons]] placed on [[Savrip Island]], which was just off the coast of Avilatan. However, Pott and her [[Squad/Legends|squad]] were unsuccessful in taking out the beacons due to the numerous hazards on the island, with six members of the squad [[Death/Legends|dying]] and half of the squad suffering severe burns. Pott eventually retreated and made use of discretionary funds to entice at least one Republic individual to brave the many dangers of the island and destroy the jamming beacons.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Let me put it this way: I've been on Ord Mantell six months. I've lost two fingers, six squad-mates and more credits than I want to think about.|Travi Pott|<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />}}
[[File:TraviPott2-TOR.png|thumb|left|180px|Sergeant Pott looking over a potential recruit]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Travi Pott was a [[Republic soldier|soldier]] who served in the [[Republic Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a period of unrest between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> Pott had attained the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] and had been mistakenly sent to fight in<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" /> the [[Separatist War]]<ref name="War">{{TORcite|type=message|Date night|Doc}} identifies the conflict as the "[[Separatist War]]."</ref> between a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|Separatist Movement]] and the Republic-backed [[Ord Mantell Central Authority|government]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />

Pott was eventually stationed on the island of [[Avilatan]] and tasked by her [[Unidentified Republic officer|commanding officer]] with leading a [[Travi Pott's squad|squad]] to destroy several Separatist [[Jammer/Legends|jamming beacons]] on [[Savrip Island]], a smaller island just off Avilatan's coast. The beacons were jamming the [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation systems]] on Republic supply [[Starship/Legends|ships]], which caused many of them to crash upon their approach to the island. Pott and her squad made several efforts to take out the beacons, but their attempts were unsuccessful due to the presence of [[Mine/Legends|mines]], Separatist forces, and dangerous beasts known as [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrips]]. During the fighting, Pott's squad [[Death/Legends|lost]] six members, while half of the squad received life-threatening burns, and Pott lost two [[Limb/Legends|fingers]] and a large amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. In addition to the heavy losses suffered by her forces, Pott also had difficulties with her equipment, which was not [[Water/Legends|waterproofed]].<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />

At some point during 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Pott gave up trying to use her squad to destroy the beacons due to the heavy casualties her [[unit]] had suffered. Instead, she took up position near a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] on the shore of [[Avilatan]] within sight of Savrip Island. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], she had become bitter and sarcastic about her situation and believed that her [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] was incompetent. However, Pott had gained access to some discretionary funds and decided that it would be better to hire someone to take out the beacons for her.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
Eventually, after being on Ord Mantell for six [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Pott enticed at least one individual who was affiliated with the Republic to venture onto the island and take out the jamming beacons using data and maps that she supplied. With the beacons destroyed and the threat to the Republic supply ships ended, Pott expressed surprise at the successful completion of the assignment and distributed the promised rewards to the involved party. Following the destruction of the beacons, she decided to hold her position until the Republic gave her a new assignment.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Yeah, Republic military training has worked out real well for me, too. I've still got eight fingers left, and half my squad-mates might survive their burns.|Travi Pott|<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />}}
At the time of the mission to destroy the jamming beacons, Travi Pott wore her [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] in a style that covered some of the left side of her face. She also had brown-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and fair skin. After she and her squad suffered many hardships, Pott became frustrated with her assignment and was willing to use discretionary funds to pay others to complete her mission. The sergeant's anger at the situation led her to be sarcastic and to criticize her commanding [[Republic officer/Legends|officer]] and her [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic military]] training.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|Only problem is, I can't do my job when every kid they assign me gets his head shot off, and my equipment isn't even waterproofed.|Travi Pott|<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />}}
While serving on Avilatan, Sergeant Travi Pott wore the Republic Army's standard suit of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with blue markings and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. After fighting on Ord Mantell for six months,<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" /> she had lost two fingers, which she had replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]].<ref name="Fingers" /> When she was assigned to destroy the jamming beacons on Savrip Island, she lacked sufficient weaponry to complete the mission, and the equipment she did have was not waterproofed. Additionally, Pott had information on the location of the jamming beacons and maps of the area that surrounded the island.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|So if you're not going to help, get out of here&mdash;you're making me a bigger target.|Travi Pott's dialogue if a player refuses the quest|<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />}}
Sergeant Travi Pott appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. She is located with a Republic medical [[Droid/Legends|droid]] on Avilatan's coastline near Savrip Island on the planet Ord Mantell, the starting planet for players of the [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] and [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|Trooper]] classes. There she gives [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] and [[Trooper/Legends|Trooper]] players the quest "Destroy the Beacons," which is designed for multiple players and can be repeated once per [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. If an eligible player who does not have the quest approaches Pott, she will call the individual over, although the player still has the choice of whether or not to speak to her and can still refuse the quest after starting the conversation. If a player who is ineligible for the quest speaks to the sergeant, she will merely give a warning about the large number of Separatist forces in the area.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" />

To complete the quest, the player must destroy four jamming beacons on Savrip Island and return to Pott, who will reward the player with 150 in-game credits, along with the player's choice of a pair of footwear appropriate for their class or three planetary commendations, which can be used to buy higher-quality gear in the game. The quest has no decisions that affect the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] or [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] alignment of the player. While the quest can be completed without a group of players and does not have to be finished to continue with the game, this article is written with the assumption of full game completion.<ref name="Destroy the Beacons" /> In Pott's dialogue, she mentions that she lost two fingers while fighting on Ord Mantell, but the in-game model for the character has ten fingers. This article therefore assumes that she had her two missing fingers replaced by cybernetics.<ref name="Fingers" />
